integrity: The mathematical proof is supplied, an exact-rational verification script runs independently on finite samples, and these checks are not external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers one-dimensional homogeneous Dirichlet heat flow with constant diffusivity, consistent P1 mass and backward Euler. It does not characterize nonhomogeneous forcing/boundary data or multidimensional meshes. A relevant 2008 full text could not be inspected; this leaves a residual priority risk.
title: Sharp backward-Euler positivity on arbitrary graded Dirichlet interval meshes
